topic: The first general-purpose electronic digital computer
core_question: What was the name of the first general-purpose electronic digital computer, completed in 1945?
answer_summary: Accept 'ENIAC' (Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer) — widely cited as the first general-purpose electronic digital computer.
